## Overview

### Did you know?

Disease elimination happens when there are no more cases of a disease in a certain geographical area.

Disease eradication happens when there are no more cases of a disease in the world.

Animated image. See caption below.

## Prevention

An infant is given oral poliovirus vaccine.

### Two types of vaccines are available to help prevent polio. [...] For example, an outbreak of wild poliovirus (imported from Pakistan) occurred in Southeastern Africa in 2021 and 2022. Ongoing conflicts and competing health priorities make it challenging to vaccinate all children in countries with wild poliovirus.

In some other countries, poliovirus variants (also known as vaccine-derived poliovirus) present an additional challenge. Variant poliovirus outbreaks emerge when not enough children are vaccinated against polio. [...] ## Key points

An infant is given oral polio vaccine.

## Progress towards eradicating polio

### Polio cases have decreased by more than 99%.

Since the launch of GPEI, polio cases have decreased by more than 99%. In addition, polio vaccines have prevented an estimated 20 million cases of paralysis in children since 1988.

title: CDC Warns Large Tuberculosis Outbreaks Doubled in US Since Mid-2010s - Newsweek
snippet: Large tuberculosis (TB) outbreaks in the country have surged sharply in recent years, doubling between 2017 and 2023, according to new data published by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) in the *Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report*. The outbreaks accounted for 1,092 cases out of nearly 62,000 TB cases reported during the seven‑year period. While the U.S. continues to have one of the lowest TB incidence rates globally, the CDC says the rise in large outbreaks signals persistent transmission within close‑contact settings, particularly among people facing social and economic instability. The CDC found that nearly 80 percent of people involved in large outbreaks were U.S.-born, a dramatic contrast to the broader TB population, where only 26 percent of cases occur in U.S.-born individuals. When TB affects the lungs, it is known as pulmonary TB, and it accounts for most of the cases involved in recent outbreaks.

title: Pharmacy COVID-19 vaccination to become advanced service - The Pharmaceutical Journal
snippet: NHS England said the pharmacy COVID-19 vaccination service will align with flu vaccination services, meaning that integrated care boards will no longer need to procure this service separately. The pharmacy COVID-19 vaccination service will become an advanced service from 1 April 2026, NHS England has announced. In its service specification for community pharmacy COVID-19 and flu services 2026/2027, published on 15 December 2025, NHS England said community pharmacies will be able to offer either COVID-19 and the adult flu vaccination services together, or just the flu vaccination service. NHS England has also confirmed the COVID-19 vaccination item of service fees will increase for 2026/2027, from £7.54 to £8.70 during the flu vaccination campaign season between 1 September 2026 and 31 January 2027, while the service fee outside the campaign season will rise to £10.06. NHS England said that pharmacy owners who want to provide the COVID-19 service must register to provide both the COVID-19 and flu vaccination services. Pharmacy owners will need to continue to use the national booking service for COVID-19 vaccination; however, this will still not be a requirement for flu.
